# TimePicker { #anylumino.TimePicker }

```python
TimePicker(
    value=None,
    min=None,
    max=None,
    step=60,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    layout=None,
    style=None,
)
```

Time picker control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                              | Default    |
|-------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `None` |
| min | optional | Minimum numeric, date, or time value. | `None` |
| max | optional | Maximum numeric, date, or time value. | `None` |
| step | optional | Increment size. | `60` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [disabled](#anylumino.TimePicker.disabled) | Enable or disable user changes. |
| [max](#anylumino.TimePicker.max) | A trait type holding a Python time object |
| [min](#anylumino.TimePicker.min) | A trait type holding a Python time object |
| [step](#anylumino.TimePicker.step) | The time step to use for the picker, in seconds, or "any". |
| [value](#anylumino.TimePicker.value) | A trait type holding a Python time object |
